title: Organizations that give to the department that pays them, and their other ties
question: Are the payees that give gifts to City departments also lobbying, tied to commissioners or flagged in contract screens?
finding: 11 of 16 organizations that gave gifts to a department paying them also appear in a lobbying, commissioner, requested-payment or contract screen. Most: San Francisco Public Health Foundation (9 influence and 16 contract screens): boardvotes: The money files that drew a no vote; boardvotes: What did not pass; chains: Chains of dealings between one payee and one official and 3 more.
how: Donors in gifts "gifts to a department from organizations the same department pays" were looked up by normalised name in every published row outside the gift screens (the two sidedoors gift screens are left out, as they repeat the gift).
limits: The rules permit a gift from a payee when it is reported; most are tickets or goods for a public programme. Large arts and health foundations appear in many screens because they hold many grants. The gift value is as the department reported it; one value printed for two gala tickets looks like a data-entry error in the source.
